We are looking for dedicated, curious, and energetic Software Engineers who embrace solving complex challenges on a global scale. As a Visa Software Engineer, you will be an integral part of a multi-functional development team inventing, designing, building, and testing software products that reach a truly global customer base. While building components of innovative payment technology, you will get to see your efforts shaping the digital future of monetary transactions.

The Work itself:

Design code and systems that touch 40% of the world population while influencing Visa’s internal standards for scalability, security, and reusability

Collaborate multi-functionally to create design artifacts and develop best-in-class software solutions for multiple Visa technical offerings

Actively contribute to product quality improvements, valuable service technology, and new business flows in diverse agile squads

Develop robust and scalable products intended for a myriad of customers including end-user merchants, b2b, and business to government solutions.

Leverage innovative technologies to build the next generation of Payment Services, Transaction Platforms, Real-Time Payments, and Buy Now Pay Later Technology

Opportunities to make a difference on a global or local scale through mentorship and continued learning opportunities

Essential Functions:

Demonstrates relevant technical working knowledge to understand requirements.

Identifies and contributes to the development and solution strategies to team members that improve the design and functionality of interface features across one or more project features, under minimal guidance.

Applies standard processes on the use of programming languages (e.g. HTML, C++, Java) to write code that fulfills website modification requests and technical requirements.

Collaborates with others to support the piloting of new technology capabilities and features that enhance the user website experience across e-commerce products.

Analyzes bugs for simple issues and applies debugging tools to verify assumptions.

 

The Skills You Bring:

Energy and Experience: A growth mindset that is curious and passionate about technologies and enjoys challenging projects on a global scale

Challenge the Status Quo: Comfort in pushing the boundaries, “hacking” beyond traditional solutions

Language Expertise: Expertise in one or more general development languages (e.g., Java, C#, C++)

Builder: Experience building and deploying modern services and web applications with quality and scalability

Learner: Constant drive to learn new technologies such as Angular, React, Kubernetes, Docker, etc.

Partnership: Experience collaborating with Product, Test, Dev-ops, and Agile/Scrum teams

 

**We do not expect that any single candidate would fulfill all of these characteristics. For instance, we have exciting team members who are really focused on building scalable systems but didn’t work with payments technology or web applications before joining Visa

**Visa does not support immigration for this role.

**Visa is not offering relocation assistance for this role.

This role sits within the Stablecoin Product team in the Commercial & Money Movement organization, driving the next generation of stablecoin enabled products and customer propositions. The position focuses on shaping long-term strategy, exploring emerging opportunities across Web3 and digital assets, and advancing innovation that fuels the future of Commercial & Money Movement solutions. As part of a high impact team operating at the intersection of new technology and legacy operations, this role helps define how stablecoins can transform customer experiences with moving money and unlock new value for clients and partners. 

 

Opportunity Assessment 

Develop and own the CMS Web3/stablecoin innovation roadmap and backlog. 

Identify and lead discovery initiatives focused on future looking opportunities across CMS. Shape initiatives around use cases identified through independent research and relationships with customers, sales, and industry partners. 

Produce executive-friendly summarize with recommendations on how to address new opportunities, including perspectives on overall market opportunities, commercial models, revenue sizing, technical flows and feasibility against a build/partner framework.

Design proofs-of-concepts including success criteria and delivery plan. 

Take an iterative, customer-centric approach with customers and partners, such as by launching a formal co-design workstream. 

Guide early stage product experimentation, from ideation through validation.

Scalable Solution Design

Articulate commercial case against scaled execution balancing needed investment and time to revenue 

Thought leadership 

Facilitate high-impact presentations, group decisions and participate on panels covering innovation roadmaps and proofs-of-concepts in internal and external forums 

Feed into marketing and communications roadmap, including producing written thought leadership pieces, blog posts, and social media content

Behind the Visa brand are our talented employees who continuously raise the bar with innovative solutions and products that deliver the convenience and security of digital currency to more people all over the world.

Sales Enablement is changing the learning culture at Visa for Sales roles and is becoming an integral part of life at the Company where every employee and client will have access to a wealth of resources to enhance their effectiveness. We are a start-up team within a large, global organization. We are a team of experts in our respective disciplines, but more importantly, we strive to harness our collective expertise in the most effective way for the benefit of learners. We combine rigor, data, and subject matter expertise with intuition and common sense of what will be most effective for the business. We like to prototype, launch, and evaluate. To this end, we champion creating, delivering, and driving impactful sales initiatives through knowledge and training to empower Visa sellers.

The Data & Analytics Managers is a crucial role for our success that will help with translation of Data from various systems into actionable insights, supporting Global markets and empower Global Sales Enablement (GSE) team to measure impact, make meaningful changes and adjustment to support Visa 2030 strategy.

Responsibilities:

Business and Data Analytics:

Be an innovative thinker passionate about brainstorming and implementing creative ways to use learning and secondary data (such as people or talent data) to measure the impact of Global Sales Enablement programs.

Extract and understand data to form opinions on how to best help and derive relevant insights for our stakeholders.

Collaborate with global and regional teams to understand their reporting and analytics needs and deliver solutions that meet these needs.

Work with stakeholders throughout the organization to identify opportunities for leveraging learning data to drive business solutions.

Visualization & Reporting:

Act as a strategic business partner, fostering strong relationships with key stakeholders to promote a data-driven decision-making culture.

Create repeatable templates for global and regional teams to leverage with stakeholders (i.e. monthly global and regional updates, participant ‘heat maps’ to track completions, etc.)

Translate complex data sets into clear and actionable visual insights that resonate with various stakeholders.

 Partner with internal stakeholders to understand their data requirements and provide expert advice on potential data solutions and visualizations.

Continuously innovate and improve dashboard designs to ensure they are user-friendly, intuitive, and aligned with business goals.

Leverage advanced visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, advanced Excel, and Watershed to develop and maintain interactive and visually appealing dashboards and reports.

Conduct needs assessments and gather requirements to ensure that dashboards meet the specific needs of different departments and teams.

Provide training and support to stakeholders on interpreting and utilizing dashboards effectively.

The M&A Technology Integration Systems Engineer is entrusted with providing strategic leadership and oversight for the integration of technology platforms and processes across newly Acquired Entities. This role is pivotal in ensuring seamless assimilation of the target company’s applications and services into the broader Visa architecture, delivering operational resiliency and availability, whilst supporting delivering against defined business objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Assessment & Scoping

Comprehensive technical due diligence to evaluate and document the target organization’s technology stack, including infrastructure, networks, applications, data platforms, and other relevant components.

Identify and articulate integration dependencies, risks, and opportunities, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives and regulatory requirements.

Support defining the scope of integration, establishing clear milestones, and set measurable success criteria in collaboration with executive stakeholders.

Communicate complex technical concepts and integration strategies with clarity and precision to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Design, develop and implement features, enhancements, Webservices, Microservices, tools and utilities in a client facing environment on a platform that is highly scalable and resilient on the N-tier architecture in Agile development life cycle.

The Senior Executive IT Support Analyst provides high‑touch, white‑glove technical support to Visa’s senior leadership and their organizations. This role is part of the Executive IT team, responsible for delivering seamless, secure, and reliable end‑user technology experiences across in‑office, remote, and travel scenarios.

The Analyst brings advanced technical expertise, polished communication, and the ability to operate under pressure while supporting executives who expect immediate, precise, and confidential IT service. This position also supports live executive events in partnership with Events, AV Operations, and onsite technical teams.

Essential Functions:

Executive Technology Support:

Deliver high‑touch IT support to executives, ensuring rapid response and issue resolution for devices, applications, conferencing tools, security tools, and collaboration platforms.

Support end‑user workstations (Windows/macOS), mobile devices, Teams Rooms, peripheral technologies, and core executive hardware with exceptional service quality.

Provide on‑site, remote, and travel‑based support during critical executive activities including board sessions, leadership meetings, investor engagements, and global events.

Event & Meeting Support:

Partner closely with Events, Live Event Support, and AV Operations to ensure seamless support for high‑visibility executive meetings, hybrid sessions, and livestreams.

Prepare technical setups, perform live support, rapidly troubleshoot issues, and coordinate technical recovery in fast‑paced event environments.

Technical Troubleshooting & Analysis:

Conduct advanced diagnostics across hardware, OS, networking, endpoint security tools, O365, collaboration platforms, and VPN.

Perform root‑cause analysis, maintain device health, and execute proactive maintenance to reduce MTTR/MTTF.

Operational Excellence:

TRAINING

The Sales Trainee (ST) is a training role.

Upon successful participation in the training program, the ST is eligible to interview for open Account Sales Manager (ASM) roles.

Upon completion of the program and certification, if no ASM or otherwise qualified role is available AND the ST is meeting performance standards, the employee may remain in the ST role up to 12-months OR until an ASM or another qualified role is available (whichever comes first).

Once an ASM or another qualified role is available, the certified ST must interview for that available role.

If promotion to the role of ACCOUNT SALES MANAGER (or other role) does not happen prior to the expiration of the 12-mos completion period, the SALES TRAINEE role will be vacated due to end of assignment unless an exception applies.

For exception, based on continued high performance, no open roles and certification completion, a manager may extend the 12-month completion period an additional 6-months.

The ST role is an at-will position, meaning that the Company or ST can terminate the employment relationship at any time, for any reason or no reason at all, with or without cause.

Price: Implements Red Bull’s recommended pricing program using best practices and available tools. Tailors presentations to address each customer’s specific needs. Proposes key account pricing that aligns with national RBNA standards and target price ranges.

Promotion: Develops an annual promotion calendar based on chain headquarters objectives. Presents Red Bull standards and price points in a way that aligns with the customer’s business priorities. Ensures all promotions are supported by effective point-of-sale materials and incremental displays.

Quality Points of Distribution (QPOD): Adapts the sales approach to meet account objectives while driving effective, permanent merchandising. Assesses return on investment before recommending specific point‑of‑sale materials or customized solutions. Executes merchandising in accordance with Channel Strategy guidelines.

Establishes a wiring model that ensures effective communication with all regional chain decision-makers.

Regularly engages in activities to build partnerships and establish strong connections at the regional, division, and banner levels within assigned chains.

Develops the necessary tools and business review templates to ensure Red Bull personnel review consistent data with local Distributor Partners (DPs), promoting uniformity across the country.

Ensures that the Region, Division, and Banner comply with annual Customer Marketing Agreements issued by chain headquarters for all assigned areas of responsibility.

Manages travel and entertainment (T&E) expenses in accordance with the assigned budget.

Works with the Head of Accounts to evaluate ROI for all regional, divisional, and banner-level programs and promotions.

Shelf/Distribution: Executes product distribution on priority packages in accordance with Channel Strategy recommendations. Ensures that all regional, divisional, and banner schematics reflect Red Bull standards and chain headquarters directives regarding product flow and package mix.

Price: Promotes and sells Red Bull’s recommended pricing program by applying best practices and using available tools. Tailors presentations to address the specific needs of each customer. Recommends key account pricing that is aligned with national RBNA standards and target price ranges.

Promotion: Develops an annual promotion calendar that supports chain headquarters objectives. Presents Red Bull standards and price points in a way that effectively addresses customer needs. Ensures that all promotions are supported with effective point-of-sale (POS) materials and incremental displays.

Quality Points of Distribution (QPOD): Adapts the sales approach to meet account objectives while driving effective, permanent merchandising. TRAINING

The Sales Trainee (ST) is a training role.

Upon successful participation in the training program, the ST is eligible to interview for open Account Sales Manager (ASM) roles.

Upon completion of the program and certification, if no ASM or otherwise qualified role is available AND the ST is meeting performance standards, the employee may remain in the ST role up to 12-months OR until an ASM or another qualified role is available (whichever comes first).

Once an ASM or another qualified role is available, the certified ST must interview for that available role.

If promotion to the role of ACCOUNT SALES MANAGER (or other role) does not happen prior to the expiration of the 12-mos completion period, the SALES TRAINEE role will be vacated due to end of assignment unless an exception applies.

For exception, based on continued high performance, no open roles and certification completion, a manager may extend the 12-month completion period an additional 6-months.

The ST role is an at-will position, meaning that the Company or ST can terminate the employment relationship at any time, for any reason or no reason at all, with or without cause.

The Sales Trainee (ST) is a training role.

Upon successful participation in the training program, the ST is eligible to interview for open Account Sales Manager (ASM) roles.

Upon completion of the program and certification, if no ASM or otherwise qualified role is available AND the ST is meeting performance standards, the employee may remain in the ST role up to 12-months OR until an ASM or another qualified role is available (whichever comes first).

Once an ASM or another qualified role is available, the certified ST must interview for that available role.

If promotion to the role of ACCOUNT SALES MANAGER (or other role) does not happen prior to the expiration of the 12-mos completion period, the SALES TRAINEE role will be vacated due to end of assignment unless an exception applies.

For exception, based on continued high performance, no open roles and certification completion, a manager may extend the 12-month completion period an additional 6-months.

The ST role is an at-will position, meaning that the Company or ST can terminate the employment relationship at any time, for any reason or no reason at all, with or without cause.

STRATEGIC BRIEFING & PARTNERSHIPS ALIGNMENT

Legal and Clearances: Ensure that all legal and compliance requirements are met across every distribution channel, including earned, managed, owned, third-party, and partner channels.

Workflow Oversight:

Owns the production workflow across multiple simultaneous campaigns, acting as the centralized project manager (the “air traffic controller”).

Timeline & Budget Control:

In coordination with the project content and production management leads, creates, manages, and enforces accurate timelines and detailed production budgets. Actively monitors budgets and revenue, identifying and resolving potential budget overruns or scope creep before they escalate.

Deliverable Tracking:

Tracks and manages the status of all creative assets and final deliverables from content teams, ensuring timely delivery to the client and distribution platforms.

QUALITY ASSURANCE & SUPPORT

Quality Control: Develop and maintain strong quality control procedures for all branded content segments. Review edits and assets from content teams to ensure they align creatively with the original brief and meet the editorial and technical standards of Red Bull Media Network.

Production Support: Actively collaborate with national and regional production teams to remove obstacles, resolve resource conflicts, and provide clear, decisive feedback to keep productions on schedule and within budget.

Process Improvement: Continually identify and implement workflow efficiencies within the branded content process to enable scalability and consistent execution across all regions.

TRAINING

The Sales Trainee (ST) is a training role.

Upon successful participation in the training program, the ST is eligible to interview for open Account Sales Manager (ASM) roles.

Upon completion of the program and certification, if no ASM or otherwise qualified role is available AND the ST is meeting performance standards, the employee may remain in the ST role up to 12-months OR until an ASM or another qualified role is available (whichever comes first).

Once an ASM or another qualified role is available, the certified ST must interview for that available role.

If promotion to the role of ACCOUNT SALES MANAGER (or other role) does not happen prior to the expiration of the 12-mos completion period, the SALES TRAINEE role will be vacated due to end of assignment unless an exception applies.

For exception, based on continued high performance, no open roles and certification completion, a manager may extend the 12-month completion period an additional 6-months.

The ST role is an at-will position, meaning that the Company or ST can terminate the employment relationship at any time, for any reason or no reason at all, with or without cause.

Upon successful participation in the training program, the ST is eligible to interview for open Account Sales Manager (ASM) roles.

Upon completion of the program and certification, if no ASM or otherwise qualified role is available AND the ST is meeting performance standards, the employee may remain in the ST role up to 12-months OR until an ASM or another qualified role is available (whichever comes first).

Once an ASM or another qualified role is available, the certified ST must interview for that available role.

If promotion to the role of ACCOUNT SALES MANAGER (or other role) does not happen prior to the expiration of the 12-mos completion period, the SALES TRAINEE role will be vacated due to end of assignment unless an exception applies.

For exception, based on continued high performance, no open roles and certification completion, a manager may extend the 12-month completion period an additional 6-months.

The ST role is an at-will position, meaning that the Company or ST can terminate the employment relationship at any time, for any reason or no reason at all, with or without cause.

EXPECTATIONS

As an RBNY Youth Coach, you will be expected to uphold our professional standards both on and off the field:

ON-FIELD RESPONSIBILITIES

Deliver sessions aligned with the RBNY philosophy and Red Print methodology.

Arrive on time with the field inspected, equipment prepared, and session plan ready.

Maintain a safe environment: check the field, secure goals, follow check-in/out procedures, and follow the two-adult rule.

Demonstrate coaching—not playing—in all sessions and games.

Carry required first-aid supplies and follow proper procedures.

OFF-FIELD RESPONSIBILITIES

Attend mandatory weekly paid education meetings (typically Tues/Wed/Thurs mornings).

Attend paid seasonal orientations.

Complete all required administrative tasks, including session plans, team reports, evaluations, timesheets, and expense reports.

PLAYER WELFARE

Treat all players with dignity and maintain appropriate physical contact guidelines.

Ensure no player is left unattended and all departures are with an approved guardian.

Promote an environment free from bullying, harassment, or misconduct.

PROFESSIONAL CONDUCT

Communicate only with parents/guardians—never directly with minors.

Do not share photos, videos, or work-related content involving players on social media.

Wear approved Adidas coaching apparel and maintain professional appearance and behavior.

Report incidents or violations promptly.

GENERAL EXPECTATIONS

Your work week includes coaching hours, administrative tasks, and required education meetings.

Adherence to all deadlines, policies, and procedures is required.

TRAINING

The Sales Trainee (ST) is a training role.

Upon successful participation in the training program, the ST is eligible to interview for open Account Sales Manager (ASM) roles.

Upon completion of the program and certification, if no ASM or otherwise qualified role is available AND the ST is meeting performance standards, the employee may remain in the ST role up to 12-months OR until an ASM or another qualified role is available (whichever comes first).

Once an ASM or another qualified role is available, the certified ST must interview for that available role.

If promotion to the role of ACCOUNT SALES MANAGER (or other role) does not happen prior to the expiration of the 12-mos completion period, the SALES TRAINEE role will be vacated due to end of assignment unless an exception applies.

For exception, based on continued high performance, no open roles and certification completion, a manager may extend the 12-month completion period an additional 6-months.

The ST role is an at-will position, meaning that the Company or ST can terminate the employment relationship at any time, for any reason or no reason at all, with or without cause.

The Director / Senior Director partners closely with the S/4 project team, Global Controllership across Global Financial Operations (GFO), Corporate, and Business Units; Operations & Technology (O&T); and various compliance groups to ensure risks are identified, mitigated, and appropriately controlled within an evolving financial systems landscape.

Responsibilities:

Identify, analyze, and remediate SoD risks / rule sets

Partner with IT, Security, and Cyber teams to ensure access controls align with business processes and internal control standards

Maintains currency on national and international intelligence topics, including but not limited to terrorist threats, political instability, and regional emerging threats.

Develops sophisticated risk assessments for NBCUniversal executives, staff, talent, and businesses.

Develops actionable proactive intelligence to mitigate threats and support corporate decision-making during a crisis.

Assists in analyzing the impact of events or threats to NBCUniversal assets through collaboration with other business units, such as News, Productions and Sports.

Builds, maintains, and leverages relationships with key external agencies, local/federal law enforcement, intelligence/military agencies and other public and private entities.

Builds relationships with other corporate and government intelligence teams to share intelligence methodologies and analysis to better support the wide variety of our company’s business groups.

Prepares appropriate risk assessments and properly communicates to the GRIC Vice President and/or relevant stakeholders on all matters of impact or potential impact in a timely manner.
